question: Which of the following modern states witnessed the origin of the ‘Vaikom’ movement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kerala** state witnessed the origin of the **"Vaikom movement".**
 
• The movement began on** 30th March 1924.**
 
• The movement is for **temple entry of the depressed classes.**
 
• It happened near the **Shiva Temple at Vaikom, Kottayam district, Kerala during 1924-25.**
 
• At that time, **Vaikom was a part of the princely state of Travancore.**
 
• Gandhiji, Chatampi Swamikal, E. V. Ramaswam
